book.name: Irina rae Fureniro
book.title: Irina rae Fureniro Iesuꞌa Irina rae Fureniroteꞌe Ḡoeꞌa

content: Ebu hena e kini ehoro iḡuꞌano ehore radiuꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌevore edaꞌeḡano soꞌa ḡuaḡa ꞌahoga horoniro. Eꞌe soꞌaḡa ḡuaḡa zamaḡano zu enoganoꞌe ḡoere mirihiro, ebu vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa mene vavaꞌoga veize kadaḡa niduꞌa fuꞌo aheu fare hina soꞌa ḡuaḡa kadane ꞌuiro.
Ebu e tuḡure viga gigiꞌaḡaniꞌa ago boro hina ꞌahige rae fureniroteꞌe horoniro, “Iniuꞌa soꞌa ḡuaḡa rana kadaḡa eꞌe mae vaḡinadu vavaꞌogaꞌe idaḡa?”
Rehano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa soꞌa ḡuaḡa vavaꞌoga zu zamaḡa ḡianoga mene idararo. Adureo ga rahao ga raha ꞌuꞌuḡano zuni oꞌoꞌa hune.
Soꞌa ḡuaḡa eꞌe vavaꞌadu zamaḡa ḡianogaꞌe idaḡa raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga mene horoniro ꞌahine, e niau rudaro.

Rehano ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahoganiꞌa ꞌahige rae ihiro, “Ago nianoꞌi. Ḡianoꞌi, Iuda urabo vazeḡa ꞌahoga, kini Davida mariga ḡihiꞌa hune, Laioni rae huneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa agire ḡauḡa raharahaniro. Aniꞌe kadaḡa fuꞌo aheu fare mae vaḡinadu soꞌa ḡuaḡa vavaꞌogaꞌe idaḡa.”

Ebu e mamoe ubuga ꞌahoga horoniro. Ani iraḡaꞌe vazeꞌa maroteꞌe heuḡa. Aniꞌe ḡaboga ḡauḡa ḡazaḡa zu ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa 24 nemaḡano, kini ehoro iḡuꞌa zama none nemao edau radiro. Ani araḡaꞌe fuꞌo aheu fare zu ubumaḡaꞌe fuꞌo aheu fare. Ubuma fuꞌo aheu fare aꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa haba niduꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe viga fuꞌo aheu fare.
Mamoe ubuganiꞌa aradu kini ehoro iḡuꞌano ehoriroteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌevore edaꞌeḡanonoꞌo soꞌa ḡuaḡa eꞌe meiro.

Aniꞌa eꞌe meirotene, ḡaboga ḡauḡa ḡazaḡa zu ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa 24ꞌa mamoe ubuga zamao ḡuḡuriro. Zeḡe niduꞌaꞌe gabizeta ebu golo hina haḡairoteꞌe ḡoḡoreḡa oboniro. Ḡoḡore eꞌe zamaḡanoꞌe ꞌuvahu hohoḡaniꞌa iriꞌaviro. ꞌUvahu hohoḡaꞌe Badiꞌa mone azaḡa kuru.
Ebu ze bada iziga ꞌahige badahiro,

content.text: zu eꞌe rana kadaḡa mae vaḡinadu soꞌa ḡuaḡa eꞌe vavaꞌogaꞌe idaḡa.
urabo niduꞌa, ḡoere nunu azaḡa niduꞌa, vaze nunu niduꞌa, zu habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa niduꞌa haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo bohaze buziro, ebu ze tutuzadu Badiꞌa haro.
Ḡaeꞌa zeꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡano tutuziro, ebu Badiꞌa veize gaueꞌeteꞌe dibuꞌo azaḡano ohoziro.
Eꞌanoꞌo zeꞌe rahao ḡau niduꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌuma.”

content: Ebu hena e tuḡure viga ḡehaḡa horoniro zu agoze igiro. Ze kini ehoro iḡuꞌa zu ḡaboga ḡauḡaḡauḡa ebu ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa varahiro. Zeꞌe ufeta ḡehaḡa bagaḡa radu zeḡe niduꞌa meꞌodoga zuni mene idararo.
Zeꞌe ago boro hina ꞌahige badahiro,

content.text: gigiꞌaḡa, maꞌoraḡa, huhuzaḡa zu inaraḡa hune.
Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe ani gubaniꞌuma zu niḡa mae ḡihiniꞌuma zu niguniꞌuma!”

content: Ebu hena adureo, rahao, raha ꞌuꞌuḡano zu davarao—habaꞌa niduꞌa zamaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa ꞌahige badaheꞌeteꞌe igiro,

content.text: “Kini ehoro iḡuꞌano ehoreꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zu Mamoe Ubuga
niguzihi, gubazihi, nize mae ḡihizihi, zu gigiꞌaze niguzihi,

content: ꞌOugadu ḡaboga ḡauḡa ḡazaḡaniꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Amen!” Ebu ekalesia ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa zu Mamoe Ubuga mazao ḡuḡuradu kuraro.
